correctness.rationale: Every crossing tile has four connection points, so a tile touching a cube edge incident to an empty face is impossible. Cube-face supports of each size 1 through 5 have only the symmetry types enumerated in the proof, and direct counting yields the stated maxima. The f=6 term is the published knot bound. Finite exhaustive replay over all 62 proper supports for each n=2..100 agrees with the formulas.

value.rationale: The recent literature introduces sf_n(K) as a new invariant but provides no inspected quantitative crossing-number lower bound on it by support size. The result supplies a structural bridge from the classical crossing number to this new invariant and produces immediate finite thresholds, for example capacities (0,0,3,6,12,19) at n=2. The claim is deliberately limited to a necessary positional bound, avoiding unsupported sharpness.
